demo.title: bilbop.sh
demo.code:
# On-chain Solana mint facts ($0.01)
bankr prompt "Use bilbop /v1/sol-mint-info for So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"

# Public token market brief ($0.01)
bankr prompt "Run bilbop /v1/sol-token-brief for mint <SPL mint>"

# Short summary ($0.01)
bankr prompt "bilbop /v1/summarize this paragraph: ..."

# Piper TTS WAV ($0.025)
bankr prompt "bilbop /v1/tts say hello from an agent"

# Human brand feedback ($0.50)
bankr prompt "bilbop /brand-feedback brand=Acme question='Would you buy again?' n=1"

setup: No install required — every endpoint is plain HTTP behind x402
Fund a Solana wallet with USDC for pay-per-call requests (no account/API key needed)
